contract: S3 credibility/generalization/boundary finite paper-oriented extension (frozen by Codex mailbox 000016, S2 APPROVE at 584569f8). Inherits the frozen iid-v1 same-distribution protocol (configs/pq-iid-protocol-v1.json) as the main domain: same Study01 grid/sample identity, generator, input representation, baseline network 256-128-64, P/Q pairing controls, training budget. Only the finite E1/E2/E3 matrix below is authorized; no scheduler/checkpoint framework, no other targets/capacities/contamination/censoring/real data/cross-scale/architecture family. Interpolation and OOD are explicitly secondary boundary checks.
run_mode: PQ_PROTOCOL=iid-v1 python -m study02pq.s3_boundary (E1/E2/E3 runners); s3_analyze reads all roots; must NOT write into pq_iid_main/pq_v3/pq_v2/historical roots
x_p_definition: x_p = gamma + eta*(-ln p)^(1/beta) with R(x_p)=p RELIABILITY lifetime (survival), i.e. CDF (1-p) quantile; NOT a CDF p-quantile (09-PQ-同分布主协议冻结.md §1.1)

target_levels.confirmatory: x0.95 remains the sole confirmatory primary result; x0.90/x0.99 are prespecified robustness results with effect sizes and design-level intervals, NOT a new familywise significance claim

capacity.scope: iid x0.95 only, all n and all 3 seeds, fixed folds {1,3}; limited-fold robustness check: report route effect, direction across capacity/n/seed, parameter counts and failures; no broad architecture-superiority claim and no formal significance claim from two folds
capacity.baseline_reuse: 256-128-64 reuses corresponding S1 results (pq_iid_main evidence at folds 1,3)

interpolation.meaning: within-domain interpolation inside the frozen Study01 beta/gamma grid; secondary boundary check
interpolation.training: retrain the 120 baseline P/Q fits deterministically in a separate interpolation artifact dir (model states were not saved for S1; do not alter or pretend to reuse S1 model files); verify deterministic identities against S1 initialization/batch/scaler contracts
interpolation.evidence_identity_check: retrained iid-test evidence must be byte-identical to S1 pq_iid_main evidence for the same fit_id (SHA256 equality)

fit_counts.E1_detail: Q0.90: 4n x 5 folds x 3 seeds = 60; Q0.99: 60; Q0.95 and P reused from S1
fit_counts.E2_detail: 2 capacities x 4 n x 2 folds {1,3} x 3 seeds x 2 routes P/Q
fit_counts.E3_detail: 4n x 5 folds x 3 seeds x 2 routes P/Q retrained baseline in pq_s3_interp
fit_counts.E4_ood: no training; reuse sealed r4/v3 gamma-holdout result (iid x0.95 Q better 3.1%; gamma-level OOD P better 8.1%) as a distinct boundary experiment; audit compatibility/state differences; do not pool iid, interpolation and OOD into one estimand

evidence_schema.compressed_per_sample: evidence/<fit_id>.npz (tracked, exact-dtype keys, float32) in each root
evidence_schema.fit_metadata: fit_metadata/<fit_id>.json (no model state; determinism + pairing SHA)
evidence_schema.interp_evidence: interp/<fit_id>.npz in pq_s3_interp (midpoint test samples, keys+hats+x95+rel_sq)
evidence_schema.sha256_rule: tracked files only; text LF-normalized; .npz binary raw; clean git archive must contain and verify every cited file

inference.e1_e3: same paired model-level squared-relative-error estimand and fold x seed crossed bootstrap as S1 (evaluate.primary_design_bootstrap / mechanism.design_pair_deltas, B=200000 final) where the design supports it; x0.90/x0.99 effect sizes and design-level intervals reported WITHOUT familywise significance claims
inference.e2: effect sizes and stratified descriptive directions appropriate to the two-fold design; no formal significance claim
inference.report_all: failures, nonfinite outputs, support violations, decoder-boundary counts; never silently drop fits or rows

mechanism_validation.sensitivity_norm_per_target: compute the dimensionless true-parameter sensitivity norm ||s|| for each target p using the S2 normalization (mechanism.row_mechanism R=p); relate target/region effects to sensitivity without claiming causality
mechanism_validation.exact_compensation_target_q: quantify exact component compensation (cancel_exact) and off-target degradation for target-specific Q using the S2 exact decomposition at the model's target level and at other levels
mechanism_validation.e4_compatibility_audit: document iid vs interpolation vs OOD state differences; keep them separate

environment.verified: hermes venv Python 3.11.9 / torch 2.12.0+cpu / numpy 2.4.6 / pandas 3.0.3

engineering.reuse: existing study02pq pipeline (training/model/losses/evaluate/mechanism/run save paths); minimal new modules only for the frozen matrix
engineering.stop_conditions: stop and report before full execution only if frozen Study01 identity cannot be preserved, P/Q pairing cannot be guaranteed, required interpolation generation changes the main-domain contract, or a code change would modify S1/S2 sealed evidence

deliverables: all 336 authorized fits or explicit blocker report

compact machine-readable target/capacity/interpolation analyses + cross-target matrix
update result report / evidence index / status / blueprint
